text: Program Overview Offered by Fanhai International School of Finance (FISF), Fudan University, GBF is a four-year full-time undergraduate finance program with a focus on data analytics and technology applications. It provides students with a comprehensive background in finance, business, data science and fin-tech, together with an in-depth understanding of China in a global environment. Elective courses are offered in two specialized fields: financial practices and quantification technology. Our graduates would be well equipped to accept the positions with top investment banks and leading commercial banks, as well as to be employed in corporate and government financial management or in consulting. Finance majors are also fully prepared for graduate studies, such as in business analytics, finance, or the law Mission To equip our students with solid financial knowledge, creative minds, practical skills, leadership spirit and social responsibility that lead to both advancement of wisdom and success in business profession. Vision To be recognized as a top program among peer institutions in Asia in providing talents who are highly competitive in the business profession. To be a center that connects alumni for generating meaningful discussions that improve the practice of business and the well-being of society. Highlights A leading and innovative Finance (Fintech stream) undergraduate program that delivers the classic theory of finance, the evolution of Fintech, and the application of quantitative and analytical skills to students ⚫ Taught in English (courses offered by FISF) ⚫ Curriculum in line with international standard that facilitates global recognition and international exchange, with a wide range of general education courses from Fudan ⚫ Courses for an in-depth understanding of China ⚫ Rigorous academic training and professional mindset fostering ⚫ Outstanding faculty ⚫ Student-oriented academic and career support
